steps.name: Field Operator
steps.text: Well... we're almost at the coordinates, if a bit off.

steps.name: Santalla
steps.text: I predicted their migration route; if we can't find anyone at the objective point, they might be somewhere closer to the coordinates.

steps.name: Santalla
steps.text: Sweet Spring and Shroomwood are both Samifjod clans with trees, and when a clan tree moves, you can't miss it.

steps.name: Field Operator
steps.text: I see...

steps.name: Field Operator
steps.text: Did you hear that, Norma? You have much to learn from Santalla.

steps.name: Scout Operator
steps.text: Yeah, yeah...

steps.name: Scout Operator
steps.text: If I could finish a five day journey in four, I wouldn't have been dismissed from the army in the first place.

steps.name: Santalla
steps.text: Actually, I may have rushed us a bit, but I was overanxious...

steps.name: Field Operator
steps.text: It's not your fault. Circumstances in Sami are complex these days. Our expedition is going north, and so are most of Sami's warriors, but the clans are heading the opposite.

steps.name: Field Operator
steps.text: At least this time we have their permission to tend to their Infected during the migration. That shows how much they trust us, so a little exhaustion is a small price to pay.

steps.name: Santalla
steps.text: ...Thank you.
Santalla presses her head close to the communicator, but can't hear anything aside from the static.
She is almost certain Ursus has already blocked the signal, but she has brought it anyway.
As long as she can get any intel on them, then the communicator is more than scrap metal.

steps.name: Field Operator
steps.text: Er, are we almost there?

steps.name: Scout Operator
steps.text: The treetops in the forest are moving. It has to be the Samifjod who requested assistance.
Who's there?!

steps.name: Santalla
steps.text: Greetings... Sweet Spring warrior.

steps.name: Sami Warrior
steps.text: How did you know—You're a shaman?

steps.name: Santalla
steps.text: A crest can tell a lot, honorable warrior.

steps.name: Santalla
steps.text: You're the one signaled for aid, I presume?

steps.name: Sami Warrior
steps.text: It was my sister. She's currently coordinating the clans, and couldn't take the time to come out and greet everyone. Apologies.

steps.name: Santalla
steps.text: Our top priority is attending to the Infected. We can save the pleasantries for once we've arrived.

steps.name: Sami Warrior
steps.text: Thank you, right this way then.

steps.name: Sami Warrior
steps.text: The Infected from the various Sami clans are all here.

steps.name: Santalla
steps.text: Faye, could you gather the other operators to do a basic check-up on everyone here?

steps.name: Field Operator
steps.text: Certainly.

steps.name: Field Operator
steps.text: Norma, get over here and translate for us!

steps.name: Scout Operator
steps.text: Alright, alright... I'm coming...

steps.name: Sami Warrior
steps.text: They seem like they're... expecting a war...

steps.name: Santalla
steps.text: Dealing with the illness has always been a war without smoke.

steps.name: Sami Warrior
steps.text: I agree.

steps.name: Sami Warrior
steps.text: It seems my sister was right, letting you people help us. Given how little we know about the disease, there could have been disputes in the clans over the treatment if you were not here.

steps.name: Santalla
steps.text: When I first arrived, I saw four Canopies moving. I presume there are four clans migrating this time?

steps.name: Santalla
steps.text: But the number of people here seemed to be off. Even if these are four great clans, they couldn't possibly have this many people.

steps.name: Sami Warrior
steps.text: If only it were just the four clans...

steps.name: Sami Warrior
steps.text: Seven, my Sami sister, there are seven clans here.

steps.name: Sami Warrior
steps.text: Among them are two clan Snowpriests who answered Eikthyrnir's call before bringing warriors and clan trees with them up north.

steps.name: Santalla
steps.text: They're bringing the clan trees?! Would Sami allow that?

steps.name: Sami Warrior
steps.text: Only Sami herself can tell...

steps.name: Sami Warrior
steps.text: In short, this place is in chaos.

steps.name: Sami Warrior
steps.text: At least we still have five clan trees with us in the center. That way we're able to rest easy at night.

steps.name: Santalla
steps.text: Five?

steps.name: Sami Warrior
steps.text: Yes, five.

steps.name: Sami Warrior
steps.text: The Colddeath clan tree is still young, so its Canopy hasn't grown past the forest roof. You could have missed it on your way here.

steps.name: Sami Warrior
steps.text: What is it?

steps.name: Santalla
steps.text: No, it's nothing.

steps.name: Santalla
steps.text: The people of the Colddeath clan... Where are they?

steps.name: Scout Operator
steps.text: (In Sami) No need to fear, your symptoms are still minor. But you should avoid picking at the lesions. It won't do anything besides making you feel worse.

steps.name: Scout Operator
steps.text: (In Sami) Yes, regularly taking shots and medication can keep your condition from worsening.

steps.name: Scout Operator
steps.text: (In Sami) Why would I lie to you? Look, I'm also Infected.

steps.name: Field Operator
steps.text: The Originium assimilation of these infected isn't looking too bad, and the medicine we brought should suffice. Once the support arrives, the Samifjod can have a portion of our rations.

steps.name: Field Operator
steps.text: Where's Santalla?

steps.name: Field Operator
steps.text: (Glances at their watch)

steps.name: Field Operator
steps.text: Norma, have you seen Santalla?

steps.name: Scout Operator
steps.text: (Sami Language) Right, just take this medicine and you should be fine. You don't need any incantation or shaman's ritual.

steps.name: Scout Operator
steps.text: Yes, what is it?!

steps.name: Field Operator
steps.text: I said, have you seen Santalla?!

steps.name: Scout Operator
steps.text: She just finished speaking with the Samifjod who's hosting us, and walked towards the edge of the crowd!

steps.name: Scout Operator
steps.text: Why, is something wrong?!

steps.name: Field Operator
steps.text: Never mind, you do your work!

steps.name: Field Operator
steps.text: (Is she... looking for her clan?)

steps.name: Field Operator
steps.text: (But isn't Santalla...)
How long had it been since she left them? Years, maybe over a decade?
Her discontent and disappointment have dissipated, melted down into a trickle of nostalgia.
She still faintly remembers a few familiar faces, and some of the clans' customs and traditions.
The warmth and beauty from her past still echoes in her memories. It's just...

steps.name: Santalla
steps.text: Greetings.

steps.name: Colddeath Warrior
steps.text: I haven't seen you before, vina.
Would the warriors of the clan recognize the daughter of snowstorm?

steps.name: Colddeath Warrior
steps.text: Which clan are you from?
She has always been honest with people, no matter friend or foe.
But today, she is doomed to spew lies.

steps.name: Santalla
steps.text: We're just outsiders passing by, tasked with delivering a message.

steps.name: Santalla
steps.text: Is your clan leader here?

steps.name: Colddeath Warrior
steps.text: She's still in her tent. I can take you to her.

steps.name: Colddeath Warrior
steps.text: What should I call you, vina?

steps.name: Santalla
steps.text: Please, call me Santalla.

steps.name: Colddeath Warrior
steps.text: Santalla, that's a nice name.

steps.name: Colddeath Warrior
steps.text: This way.

steps.name: Santalla
steps.text: Thank you...
Once, she resented her people for forsaking the old tree.
Now, she is the one forsaken by her people.
She walks past her clansmen. Familiar faces now look at her with unfamilar eyes.
They are curious about this 'outsider.'
Who, in magnificent clothes and holding a steel staff in hand, walks among the children of Sami.
No one could recollect, since there's nothing to recollect.
Forsaken. Forgotten.

steps.name: Colddeath Warrior
steps.text: This is the place. Please wait while I go inform.

steps.name: Colddeath Warrior
steps.text: Come on in.

steps.name: Santalla
steps.text: Thank you...

steps.name: Colddeath Shaman
steps.text: I welcome your visit, vina. What can I do for you?

steps.name: Santalla
steps.text: You are... Eras's granddaughter?

steps.name: Colddeath Shaman
steps.text: That I am.

steps.name: Santalla
steps.text: I remember the interim clan chief being your brother. What happened to him?

steps.name: Colddeath Shaman
steps.text: He...

steps.name: Colddeath Shaman
steps.text: My brother went along with Eikthyrnir's march towards the north. I act as clan leader on his behalf for the moment.

steps.name: Colddeath Shaman
steps.text: And who exactly are you, if I may ask?

steps.name: Santalla
steps.text: The forsaken child, rescued by the branches of the old tree. Daughter of the Santalla tree. Do these words ring a bell to you?

steps.name: Colddeath Shaman
steps.text: Forsaken, you say...

steps.name: Colddeath Shaman
steps.text: I'm truly very sorry... I only remember the ceremony where we bid the old tree farewell. Everything about our days when it yet lived, or the people we've lost, they are beyond me.
She, too, belongs to the past now.
Just like the old tree.

steps.name: Santalla
steps.text: ...It's alright.

steps.name: Colddeath Shaman
steps.text: So I take it the business about delivering a message was an excuse?

steps.name: Santalla
steps.text: I do apologize...

steps.name: Colddeath Shaman
steps.text: I don't blame you. My clan has experienced so much displacement, and much was lost, including our past with people like you.

steps.name: Colddeath Shaman
steps.text: If there's anything you need, just say the word.
She honestly hopes that others might remember her, but what would happen if they do?
What would an outcast of the past change?
The wind of Sami has taken with it her story...
Let it leave, then, along with her regret.

steps.name: Santalla
steps.text: You would excuse my rudeness, Alma of the birchbranch.

steps.name: Santalla
steps.text: I am an outcast of Colddeath, daughter of the Santalla tree, Simone. By our rules and customs, I should never have returned to the clan.

steps.name: Santalla
steps.text: But I still want do something for the clan before I leave.

steps.name: Santalla
steps.text: If, of course, you would allow it.

steps.name: Colddeath Shaman
steps.text: How do you know my name?

steps.name: Colddeath Shaman
steps.text: I... I see.

steps.name: Colddeath Shaman
steps.text: You were... a part of the clan.

steps.name: Colddeath Shaman
steps.text: Well...

steps.name: Colddeath Shaman
steps.text: As you can see, we are still in the midst of migrating, and there have been trivial issues that require our attention along the journey. However, we have been able to manage, thus they need not concern you.

steps.name: Colddeath Shaman
steps.text: But our home... I'm talking about where we lived after we moved to the woodlands. We were unable to hold a ceremony to comfort our ancestors before we left there.

steps.name: Santalla
steps.text: Because of the disaster in the north?

steps.name: Colddeath Shaman
steps.text: Yes... Certain phenomena were about to pollute our shelter, so we were in a hurry to leave.

steps.name: Colddeath Shaman
steps.text: Our clan still doesn't have a new Snowpriest, and our shamans are feeble against the disaster.

steps.name: Colddeath Shaman
steps.text: You're also a shaman, aren't you?

steps.name: Santalla
steps.text: I am capable of performing a shaman's duties, yes.

steps.name: Colddeath Shaman
steps.text: Then may I entrust you with this matter?

steps.name: Santalla
steps.text: You will not be disappointed.

steps.name: Colddeath Shaman
steps.text: I'm very sorry, daughter of the Santalla tree. You offer your earnest assistance while we fail to recognize our sister.

steps.name: Santalla
steps.text: It doesn't matter anymore, Alma. We all ought to leave stories from the past behind us.

steps.name: Santalla
steps.text: Farewell then, leader of the Colddeath clan.

steps.name: Santalla
steps.text: May we meet at the other side of Sami's spine.

steps.name: Colddeath Shaman
steps.text: *sigh*...

steps.name: Colddeath Shaman
steps.text: A strange one indeed. Perhaps she was once Grandpa's student?

steps.name: Colddeath Shaman
steps.text: If Grandpa were still here, he'd probably ask me to be confident and humble a leader as her.

steps.name: Colddeath Shaman
steps.text: (Pulls out the amber pendant that she carries with her)

steps.name: Colddeath Shaman
steps.text: If you had came across something like this, how would you deal with it?

spans.text: If you had came across something like this, how would

steps.text: The shaman stares in a trance at the pendant left to her by a departed friend. A gift she got as a child, from a young apprentice shaman she used to play with.
She still remembers that she was a Feline.
And her eyes were exactly like the visitor just now...

steps.name: Field Operator
steps.text: Ah, Santalla, you're back.

steps.name: Santalla
steps.text: Mhm.

steps.name: Santalla
steps.text: You have enough hands here?

steps.name: Field Operator
steps.text: We'll manage.

steps.name: Santalla
steps.text: Then I have something else to attend to.

steps.name: Santalla
steps.text: Some clansmen reported that the collapsal paradigm was approaching where they lived at the time. If the collapse has been heading where we are now, it will be a problem.

steps.name: Santalla
steps.text: I need to look into it.

steps.name: Field Operator
steps.text: Are you going alone? Isn't that... risky?

steps.name: Santalla
steps.text: Having more untrained hands isn't going to help.

steps.name: Santalla
steps.text: I was trained as a shaman. I know how to handle corruption, and I'm the only one here with the power to solve it.

steps.name: Santalla
steps.text: It will be fine.

steps.name: Field Operator
steps.text: Well...

steps.name: Field Operator
steps.text: I should report this to the office right now, at least. They need to send a few shamans, preferably Snowpriests, to come help us.

steps.name: Field Operator
steps.text: There's also Typhon. After she returns with the expedition team, she needs to to go take a look there.

steps.name: Santalla
steps.text: Where is the last expedition team set off now?

steps.name: Field Operator
steps.text: They should have made their way across the forest as we're talking. It's just some mountain paths they will have to walk before they enter the icefield.

steps.name: Santalla
steps.text: Then we need to contact them. Better safe than sorry.

steps.name: Field Operator
steps.text: I'm already making calls.

steps.name: Field Operator
steps.text: Well then... take care on your journey, Santalla.

steps.name: Santalla
steps.text: My apologies for the additional workload I just imposed on you.

steps.name: Field Operator
steps.text: It's no problem at all.

steps.name: Scout Operator
steps.text: Did Santalla leave already?

steps.name: Field Operator
steps.text: Dude, you sound like you've never worked with her before...

steps.name: Field Operator
steps.text: Sami's oddities are still way out of our league. It's not like we can solve anything without troubling her.

steps.name: Field Operator
steps.text: How are the Infected doing?

steps.name: Scout Operator
steps.text: They are being very cooperative and calm. For the time being there's nothing that demands our attention.

steps.name: Field Operator
steps.text: Phew....That's good to hear.

steps.name: Field Operator
steps.text: Then I need to ask you to lend a hand, Norma. We need to send an urgent telegram to Čappat.
A few days later...

steps.name: Santalla
steps.text: This is the place.

steps.name: Santalla
steps.text: Is there a signal here?

steps.name: Santalla
steps.text: (Operates the communicator)

steps.name: Santalla
steps.text: Might not be the signals...

steps.name: Santalla
steps.text: Demons?
Naturally, there is no response. A giant shadow somewhat resembling a clan tree approaches.

steps.name: Santalla
steps.text: The shadow of Colddeath's clan tree is wandering about in daylight?

steps.name: Santalla
steps.text: No prominent signs of hostility, but definitely not peaceful

steps.name: Santalla
steps.text: This is an omen of disaster.

steps.name: Santalla
steps.text: Let's give the Columbian way a try...

steps.name: Santalla
steps.text: Next up is...

steps.name: Santalla
steps.text: (Takes out a mini calculator)

steps.name: Santalla
steps.text: (Presses a few buttons without looking at the numbers)

steps.name: Santalla
steps.text: The results are completely inconsistent...

steps.name: Santalla
steps.text: Ugh...

steps.name: Santalla
steps.text: As long as the corruption lingers, any solution is futile.

steps.name: Santalla
steps.text: O ancestral spirits of Colddeath, pray forgive my neglect.

steps.name: Santalla
steps.text: I will be back soon.

steps.name: Santalla
steps.text: Without a clan tree, there's no sanctuary from the corruption.

steps.name: Santalla
steps.text: In that case... the old tree shall shelter its people one last time.
Santalla takes out a dead twig of the old tree—her last tribute to it. She cuts her own finger, and the blood drips onto the dry twig before falling into the ground.

steps.name: Santalla
steps.text: Heed me, O the Eternal, and return the unfaltering tranquility to the land.
When Santalla's blood hits the ground, it turns into clear water. Under the influence of her Arts, it quickly turns to frost and spreads.
Clean frost swarms over the dead branch, which seizes the chance to burrow into the earth, attracting the gaze of the past.
The gray fog shrouding the rising moon begins to disperse. However, the vegetation still grows gradually more yellow and listless.
The past is both a blessing and a curse.

steps.name: Santalla
steps.text: Not good enough...
Santalla looks around before landing her eyes where the clan tree has taken roots.
She picks up some twigs and leaves. Untainted by the corruption, Sami’s primal vitality lives on within them.

steps.name: Santalla
steps.text: These will suffice.
Branches, both old and new, are woven together, and crushed tender leaves are scattered on the ground.
Through Santalla’s ritual, they have become the symbols of her intent.

steps.name: Santalla
steps.text: Arbora, Soknarferd.

steps.name: Santalla
steps.text: May the past tie to the present, whilst the tree erects tall.

steps.name: Santalla
steps.text: May the eyes ever keep vigil, be they standing or fallen.

steps.name: Santalla
steps.text: All-Father, spirits of ancestors, souls who roam upon the earth.

steps.name: Santalla
steps.text: Bear witness.... Bear witness to me!

steps.name: Santalla
steps.text: Heed and answer the plea of Simone, daughter of the Santalla tree.

steps.name: Santalla
steps.text: Cleanse the land of its filth, and bring back Sami's purity!
Twigs entwine into 'Arbora,' and leaves patrol on 'Soknarferd.'
The proclamations that answer only the beckons of Foldartals now manifest at the call of the shaman's call.
The collapse ceases in an instant, and nature begins to regain its former vitality.
However, at the edge of the forest, a dense dark fog refuses to disperse.
This pestilence and the source of most of Sami's corruption.

steps.name: Santalla
steps.text: The Black Mark...!
(Heavy breathing sounds)
Within an instant, the snow and ice around Santalla coagulate into a sharp blade darting at the figure.
An Emperor's Blade can finish off any unprepared challenger in a blink of eye.
And in the face of a Demon-taken Blade, her chance is even grimmer.

steps.name: Santalla
steps.text: *Pant*... *pant*...
She can choose to press on her attack, which would only send more Demon escaping from the enemy before her.
But if nothing is done, it would butcher all life around them, corrupt the earth, and trample over every inch of Sami land.
Even though the blessings summoned by the Foldartal are still in effect, Santalla still had to consider the calamity each attack would bring.
This isn't a battle.
And she is relieved for the fact.
The Black Mark staggers forward, stepping out and taking an offensive stand.
However, with its next step it disappears into thin air right before her eyes.
Under nature's purification, the collapsal had vanished without a trace.

steps.name: Santalla
steps.text: It ran away?

steps.name: Santalla
steps.text: But that's...

steps.name: Santalla
steps.text: Is there anything I can do to help?

steps.name: Field Operator
steps.text: Not yet, we just spoke to the Rhodes Island operators in Skarphaket. They coordinated with members of an expedition team that had just set off, and sent them sufficient support.

steps.name: Santalla
steps.text: Where is the last expedition team set off now?

steps.name: Field Operator
steps.text: They should have made their way across the forest as we're talking. It's just some mountain paths they will have to walk before they enter the icefield.
They were near the location of the expedition team, and though calamities appear unpredictably, there are always omens...
For example...
If there is more life, more beings returning to nothingness.

steps.name: Santalla
steps.text: I'm going to have to let Typhon know at once.

steps.name: Santalla
steps.text: O noble Sami, please forgive me my transgression.
Santalla lifts her staff and plunges it into the earth.
The frost on the ground forms shapes as she wills.

steps.name: Santalla
steps.text: Enginna... Enginna...

steps.name: Santalla
steps.text: O Sami, I know you watch over their fate.

steps.name: Santalla
steps.text: Please take this omen, and send it to my friend.
Following her request, the pattern of ice rapidly disperses, and the ground is once again as dry as ever.

steps.name: Santalla
steps.text: Everyone's safety depends on you, Typhon.

steps.name: Santalla
steps.text: I... still have more I was entrusted with.
Santalla had hunted a hornbeast and picked some fruit.
These were to be presented as sacrificial offerings to the ancestors.
It wasn't much, but it would suffice to comfort the Colddeath ancestors.

steps.name: Santalla
steps.text: Father, Mother, Snowpriest Eras, and all the ancestors.

steps.name: Santalla
steps.text: By the will of the clan leader, I come here to offer up these sacrificial offerings to you.

steps.name: Santalla
steps.text: May the ancestors protect our people, care for their restless hearts, and guide their way in their dreams.

steps.name: Santalla
steps.text: I also hope...

steps.name: Santalla
steps.text: That people will remember you. That you will be spared the worry of being forgotten.

steps.name: Santalla
steps.text: I look forward to it.
With a burst of flame, the sacrificial offerings disappear into the fire and enter the food basket of the ancestors.
All throughout the night, Santalla stares at the flames. Once they've burnt out, she slowly falls asleep.

steps.name: Santalla
steps.text: Huh?

This order is being sent to all search teams. An area believed to be damaged by Obsidian was discovered. Nearby teams are requested to act immediately. Confirm the reports at the specified coordinates and withdraw. Do NOT enter the damaged area.
Repeat, do NOT—

steps.name: Santalla
steps.text: Obsidian?

steps.name: Santalla
steps.text: That's the direction the Black Mark came from.

steps.name: Santalla
steps.text: The Ursus are still hiding something!
Santalla glances at the sacrificial site and where the Foldartals had appeared.
The offerings had been reduced to ash, the living and dead branches were still entwined.
She thinks for a moment, then scatters a handful of ash over the roots of the branches.
Then, she leaves the woodlands towards the direction indicated by the Ursus.
She would never return.

steps.name: Santalla
steps.text: These are the coordinates.

steps.name: Santalla
steps.text: It's already deep in the icefields. What could the Ursus be planning?

steps.name: Santalla
steps.text: I can feel the corruption in this place...

steps.name: Santalla
steps.text: Is it... here?
Fierce snowstorms shroud the area, as if trying to hide something.
But before Santalla's will, the snowstorm seems to dissipate.
It finally unveils the truth within:
Three Royal Guards, wrapped in Dominion.
Fear grips her soul for a moment, and something seems to come back from the void, ready to turn its sights on her location.
However, the snowstorm blows in just in time, shrouding her in its winds.

steps.name: Santalla
steps.text: (Corrupted or not, they could have killed me then and there.)

steps.name: Santalla
steps.text: (What happened here?)
She composes herself and waits until her mood has steadied before stepping out of the snowstorm. Then she walks towards the edge of the Dominion.
At its center, the three Royal Guards remain motionless.
This time, she can see them clearly.
Each of them had pierced their own hearts with an Ursine sabre.
Maybe it was Originium Arts, maybe some kind of spell.
Their bodies hadn't been blown over by the winds, nor were they used by demons.
They maintained the posture of their final moments, before being engulfed by their own Dominion.
Santalla then notices that they are positioned as if there were four of them, standing back-to-back before they were killed.
In the empty space, there is only an Ursine saber stuck in the snow.

steps.name: Santalla
steps.text: Is this where you came from, Black Mark?
The great deeds of the Ursus were far outweighed by their evil ones.
But here, at least, what these heroes had done with their lives was more than enough to move the Samifjod.

steps.name: Santalla
steps.text: (Sami had no other intentions. The snowstorms protect this place to guard these people in their sleep.)

steps.name: Santalla
steps.text: (I salute you, warriors.)

steps.name: Santalla
steps.text: (The Ursus aren't far from here.)

steps.name: Santalla
steps.text: (I'll remove the snowstorms, so you can safely return home.)
At the same time, however, there is something on her mind.

steps.name: Santalla
steps.text: (So even the collective acts of the entire Ursus war machine can only end like this...)

steps.name: Santalla
steps.text: (Eikthyrnir, when you tore apart Sami's clans and gambled the future of the Samifjod on a hopeless expedition, did you ever think about the consequences?)

steps.name: Santalla
steps.text: (Sami promised you I would not interfere.)

steps.name: Santalla
steps.text: (But I am also a part of Sami.)

steps.name: Santalla
steps.text: (I will use my own methods, and together with my allies from the south, we will win a better future for Sami.)

steps.name: Santalla
steps.text: All-Father, please bear witness to my resolve.

steps.name: Santalla
steps.text: O snowstorm, follow me, and leave these heroes to their attendants.

steps.name: Santalla
steps.text: In my next life, I will offer wine to the ancestral spirits among the branches and leaves.

steps.name: Santalla
steps.text: Farewell, souls of the Ursus.
She disappears into the blizzard, and it dissipates shortly after.
It wasn't long before the Ursus sounded their horns on the icefields.
Two weeks later...

steps.name: Santalla
steps.text: I'm back.

steps.name: Field Operator
steps.text: S-Santalla!

steps.name: Santalla
steps.text: Wh-What's wrong? Why are you so nervous?

steps.name: Field Operator
steps.text: You've been gone for so long! Any longer and I would've reported to the landship that you went MIA!

steps.name: Santalla
steps.text: Am I not back now?

steps.name: Field Operator
steps.text: I know you're dealing with a lot of things. But next time, please help me prepare myself, mentally. What would we do if you disappeared one day?

steps.name: Santalla
steps.text: Okay, it's my fault, I'm sorry Faye.

steps.name: Field Operator
steps.text: Don't think you can get out of this with just an apology...

steps.name: Santalla
steps.text: I'll make you some roasted hornbeast, alright?

steps.name: Field Operator
steps.text: Roasted hornbeast?!

steps.name: Santalla
steps.text: Are we settled, then?

steps.name: Field Operator
steps.text: Hmph... Seeing how you're being so sincere, I'll overlook it just this once.

steps.name: Santalla
steps.text: Thank you, Faye, you're a true friend.

steps.name: Field Operator
steps.text: F-Flattery will get you nowhere.

steps.name: Santalla
steps.text: Hehe.

steps.name: Santalla
steps.text: Ah right, has the expedition team returned yet?

steps.name: Field Operator
steps.text: Ah... Of course, no one told you.

steps.name: Field Operator
steps.text: The expedition team ran into some trouble before entering the icefields. Some sort of horrible monster, like the ghost of an Ursus officer or something.

steps.name: Field Operator
steps.text: Luckily, Typhon was prepared, and everyone withdrew in time. Otherwise there would be casualties. Which, well, would be hard to explain.

steps.name: Santalla
steps.text: I see, that's good to hear.

steps.name: Santalla
steps.text: What about the clans who migrated south?

steps.name: Field Operator
steps.text: They found a place to settle down. The Infected, if they so wish, can still live with their clan and visit Rhode's Island's Sami clinic for treatment.

steps.name: Santalla
steps.text: Oh, that's good.

steps.name: Santalla
steps.text: Then I have nothing to worry about.

steps.name: Field Operator
steps.text: Ah, Santalla, where are you heading this time?

steps.name: Santalla
steps.text: Just back to the dorms to take a nap.

steps.name: Field Operator
steps.text: Oh, so even you know how to rest. Finally.

steps.name: Santalla
steps.text: Then tomorrow we'll visit Skarphaket and meet up with Magallan and Typhon.

steps.name: Field Operator
steps.text: I take it back, you're unstoppable.

steps.name: Santalla
steps.text: This is what every Sami shaman... what every Rhodes Island operator should be doing, no more and no less.

steps.name: Field Operator
steps.text: If I worked as hard as you, I'd be sent to Medical within a month.

steps.name: Field Operator
steps.text: I know this work is important, but that's all the more reason to balance it out with proper rest.

steps.name: Santalla
steps.text: And to me, taking a nap here is proper enough.

steps.name: Field Operator
steps.text: That's not going to cut it, you really need get some sleep.

steps.name: Field Operator
steps.text: We can save the rest for tomorrow.

steps.name: Field Operator
steps.text: Now go on, go.

steps.name: Santalla
steps.text: Ah...

steps.name: Santalla
steps.text: Fine, fine, I'll rest.

steps.name: Santalla
steps.text: Thank you, Faye.

steps.name: Field Operator
steps.text: Sweet dreams, Santalla.

steps.name: Santalla
steps.text: Yes, goodnight.
